behavior: Nearest palette colour for an RGB query, transparent index 0 excluded: editor palette_find_closest vs D2CMP.dll 1.13c 0x9d30

count.note: 255 entries; other counts are outside this contract

exact_colour_per_index.note: every index 1..255 of the main palette

transparent_index_0.note: excluded by both: the editor skips it, the reference is given entries 1..255

domain.description: 336 distinct authored (palette, rgb) queries over 2 authored palettes; not all 2^24 colours or all palettes

limitations: Compares the search algorithm under the editor's RGBA memory order. It does not establish which channel order the game's own palettes or callers use.
Only AL is compared; EAX bits 8..31 are not a result of the routine.
Finite authored domain; palettes with alpha/gamma handling are out of scope.

abi_recipe.convention: stdcall: 5 dword stack arguments, callee pops 0x14 (RET 0x14)
abi_recipe.distance: 32-bit sum of (byte_k - c_k)^2 over k=0..2; compared UNSIGNED (JNC)
abi_recipe.entry_layout: stride 4; byte0 is compared with c0, byte1 with c1, byte2 with c2; byte3 is never read
evidence: PE .reloc of the identified D2CMP.dll: no fix-up inside RVA 0x9d30..0x9da0
abi_recipe.hidden_state: none: no global reads or writes, no calls, no relocations

marshalling.palette_memory: 1024 scratch bytes in the editor's RGBA_PALETTE order (r,g,b,a per entry)

abi_recipe.register_inputs: none: ECX is pushed as the local best-index slot and reloaded from [esp+0xc] before use; EAX/EDX/ESI/EDI/EBP are not read
abi_recipe.return: AL = relative index of the minimum; EAX bits 8..31 hold bits of `count` (or 0 when count==0) and are not part of the result
abi_recipe.search: relative indices 0..count-1 from `entries`; count==0 returns 0 without reading memory
abi_recipe.tie_policy: strict less-than against the running minimum (initially 0xFFFFFFFF): the first (lowest) relative index at the minimum wins
abi_recipe.writes: none outside its own stack frame
